DRIVER'S HANDBOOK

Desi Roads — 3D Indian Highway Simulator

Experience the freedom and nostalgia of driving an authentic hand-painted Indian heavy commercial truck across procedural stretches of National Highway 44.

The Spirit of NH 44 & Truck Art

National Highway 44 (NH 44) is the longest north-south highway in India, traversing from Srinagar in the Himalayas all the way to Kanyakumari at the southern tip. Every kilometer tells a story of trade, culture, and life on the asphalt.

The truck in Desi Roads celebrates India's vibrant truck art heritage: from the iconic "Horn OK Please" and floral calligraphy to bright marigold tassels, evil-eye wardens (buri nazar wale tera muh kala), and decorated wooden chassis sideboards.

Roadside Dhabas & Chai Stalls

No Indian road trip is complete without the roadside dhaba. As you navigate the winding curves, you'll encounter procedural highway eateries, charpai seating, tandoors, and fresh steaming chai stalls.

DESI ROADS RADIO Stations

  • Highway FM (88.1): Lo-fi chill and ambient driving beats for peaceful highway cruising.
  • 80s Bollywood (93.5): Classic retro Hindi road-trip anthems, disco classics, and vintage melodies.
  • Punjabi Dhaba (101.2): High-energy Bhangra, folk dhol beats, and modern Punjabi truck vibes.
  • 90s Nostalgia (106.4): Golden 90s monsoon melodies and highway favorites.

Driving Controls Manual

  • W / Up Arrow: Throttle & Acceleration (Heavy diesel engine torque)
  • S / Down Arrow: Brake & Reverse
  • A / D or Left / Right: Smooth Steering with speed-adaptive response
  • Spacebar: Emergency Handbrake & Drift Friction
  • H Key: Indian Triple-Tone Pressure Air Horn
  • M Key: Toggle Truck Engine Audio / Mute
  • T Key: Cycle Lighting Presets (Golden Hour, Monsoon Green, Night Cruise)
  • L Key: Turn Headlights On / Off
  • C Key: Switch Camera View (Third-Person Chase, Hood Cam, Drone Orbit)
  • P Key: Engage Autopilot Highway Cruise Mode (100 km/h)
  • R Key: Reset Truck Position
  • I Key: Toggle Driver Handbook & Lore

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I play Desi Roads on mobile without installing an app?

Yes! Desi Roads is an instant WebGL browser game designed for both mobile and desktop. On touch screens, intuitive steering and pedal buttons appear automatically.

How does the procedural highway generation work?

The road is generated using dynamic cubic spline chunks and simplex noise with elevation smoothing. As you drive forward, new highway segments and roadside dhabas are created ahead and recycled behind seamlessly.

How do I share a specific trip setup with friends?

Click the Share button in the top HUD or below to copy a custom URL containing your active lighting theme, radio station, and autopilot status.
